files.content:
# Shiny Text

A moving text-clipped highlight converted from ReactBits to HTML-in-Canvas with transparent WebGL output. Vanilla owns the animation clock, capture, renderer and native editing; React owns lifecycle, props and a readable DOM fallback. The installed component has no Motion, GSAP, Bencho or WebGPU dependency.

## Usage

```tsx
import ShinyText from "./ShinyText";

<ShinyText
  text="✨ Shiny Text Effect"
  speed={2}
  color="#71717a"
  shineColor="#27272a"
  style={{ height: 240, fontSize: 32, fontWeight: 600 }}
  onTextChange={(text) => console.log(text)}
/>
```

Double-click anywhere in the effect area to edit. A focused effect also accepts Enter or F2. Single-click does not activate the editor; Escape or blur ends editing. The idle editor does not block hover interaction. Local text survives unrelated setting updates; a changed explicit `text` prop replaces it. Empty text remains editable. A public `editable={false}` opts out at application level; there is no Editable setting in the preview.

## Props

| Prop | Knob | Default | Range | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| text | Text | "" | Free text | string |
| disabled | Disabled | false | true / false | boolean |
| speed | Speed | 2 | 0.1–10 s | number |
| color | Color | "#b5b5b5" | CSS color | string |
| shineColor | Shine color | "#ffffff" | CSS color | string |
| spread | Spread | 120 | 0–360 deg | number |
| yoyo | Yoyo | false | true / false | boolean |
| pauseOnHover | Pause on hover | false | true / false | boolean |
| direction | Direction | "left" | "left" / "right" | string |
| delay | Delay | 0 | 0–5 s | number |
| className | — | "" | CSS class names applied to the animated text span | string |
| style | — | undefined | Inherited typography and host dimensions | CSSProperties |
| onTextChange | — | undefined | Committed text callback | function |

`text` is empty when omitted, matching the source. The site supplies its demonstration sentence and typography separately. `speed` and `delay` use seconds. The source defines no animation-complete callback for this repeating effect.

## Vanilla

```ts
import { createShinyText } from "./ShinyTextVanilla";

const effect = createShinyText({ source, content, output, editor }, {
  props: { text: "Shiny text", speed: 2, pauseOnHover: true },
  editable: true,
  onTextChange: console.log,
});
effect?.setOptions({ props: { direction: "right", yoyo: true } });
effect?.resize();
effect?.destroy();
```

Place `content` inside a `source` canvas and provide a sized, positioned host. The source remains layout-visible but opacity-zero; only the transparent output is displayed. The editor is outside the hidden source. If HIC or WebGL cannot initialize, the factory returns `null` and React displays the fallback. No site font files are required.

## Source fidelity

- Source: ReactBits `src/content/TextAnimations/ShinyText/ShinyText.jsx`, frozen revision `5d0b85bb2f7cd36c578e93e01134517fae1cd201`; demo and both TypeScript variants were audited.
- Gradient stops are 0%, 35%, 50%, 65%, 100%, background size is 200% auto, and background position is `150 - 2 × progress` percent. Left and right invert the calculated progress.
- The first frame initializes time without advancing. Disabled and hover pause freeze the current position, retaining elapsed time; the first resumed frame also has no time delta. Changing direction resets elapsed/progress, while other prop changes retain elapsed time.
- Yoyo alternates forward, end delay, reverse, start delay. Disabled freezes rather than removes the highlight. The source hover handlers only change pause state while `pauseOnHover` is true; turning that flag off while already hovered does not itself unpause the source.
- Intentional extensions: double-click editing with IME, cleanup, unsupported-browser fallback and a readable static reduced-motion state. These are not claimed as features of the original ReactBits implementation.
